h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gaya

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gaya

c: Pilgrims and visitors come to Gaya and nearby Bodh Gaya all year, and the hotels, guest houses and institutions that host them are a growing group of buyers for outdoor fitness equipment. So are the schools, colleges, residential colonies and municipal parks of the city itself. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to all of them, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,380 km from Gaya.

We dispatch by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. A hotel garden usually wants a few calm, good-looking machines that guests can use without help. A city park needs sturdier, busier stations. Send us the size of your space and a few photos, and we will suggest a set and mark the clear area for each machine on a layout drawing.

items.q: Is outdoor gym equipment suitable for a hotel garden?
items.a: Yes. A few simple machines such as a Tai Chi wheel, Fun Cycle and Leg Extension give guests easy exercise. Choose a colour and placement that suits the garden.

items.q: Which machines are gentle on older users?
items.a: Tai Chi wheels, walkers, seated twisters and the Fun Cycle are low-impact. They use only body weight and a slow, steady motion, so older users can go at their own pace.

items.q: How do you deliver to Gaya?
items.a: We send the machines by road from our factory in Vasai and install them with our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing.
